precedence: This override is higher authority only for the Admin Portal Login Details lookup. All non-conflicting Portal V2, Admin batch creation, Replace Resource and shared-Worker authority remains binding.

requiredBehaviour.secretBoundary: The lookup confirms whether stored Login and Answer Pack credentials exist but does not return the credential values themselves.
requiredBehaviour.notFoundRule: Unknown Portal IDs return STUDENT_NOT_FOUND without creating or mutating an account.

nonMutationInvariants: Do not reset or replace Login or Answer Pack passwords.
Do not write, delete or rewrite STUDENTS_KV.
Do not change student batch assignments.
Do not change lesson entitlements, prepared access, Trial consumption, sessions or account state.
Do not use the lookup as a substitute for student provisioning or account repair.

implementation.adminUi: assets/admin-create-batch.js adds the Portal Login Details card/section alongside the existing Student Login Manager without replacing the batch-creation UI.

completionBoundary.repository: Source, route wiring, Admin UI, tests and authority must be coherent on main.
completionBoundary.production: Shared Worker deployment must preserve quiz bridge, Admin, Trial, protected-view, Replace Resource and batch-create capabilities and the lookup route must remain protected without an Admin session.
completionBoundary.browser: Owner verification is required before changing status to CLOSED_PASS_OWNER_VERIFIED.

authorityUpdateRule: Any change to returned fields, credential exposure, authentication, canonical source or mutation semantics requires updating this override and GCH_CURRENT.json in the same coherent change.
